items.title: Gerald Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the only two blacks that were in it was Benny Carter and Quincy Jones. So Billy May... called me... I joined ASMAC and I felt great, I was in there with guys like David Rose

ctx.x: Where is he based, here or in New York?

No, he’s from California, they were all in this school together along with Quincy Jones’ son went to this little school. Uh, Cher, her daughter went to this little school. They called it education, early for education, something for early education, off of Lauser, right off of Lauser Indica, right off of Lauser Indica, yeah.
That was probably where Benny Golson’s daughter went too ‘cause he was talking about going to school with all these other kids but anyway. Go ahead…
